emma_support: FYI incoming customer escalation (ACME, case #220432). They upgraded to the latest py sdk and are seeing 500s + what looks like duplicate charges from retries.
emma_support: Customer says it started after `pip install redwood-sdk==1.38.0` yesterday. Sharing logs and a minimal repro below.
customer-ops: repro script (sanitized):
```python
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key=... , retries=3)
res = cli.generate(model='rwd-small', input='hello')
print(res)
```
They say two requests are hitting backend for one API call in ~15% of requests. Header shows no idempotency key in outgoing request.
customer-ops: logs: `2026-03-12T18:22:01Z → POST /v1/generate 200 id=req_abc123`, then immediately `2026-03-12T18:22:01Z → POST /v1/generate 200 id=req_def456` 
customer-ops: Billing spike corresponds to those dup requests.
raj_engineer: Can you confirm the exact sdk version and the code path? also paste the client init args (no secrets).
customer-ops: Confirmed: `redwood-sdk==1.38.0`, python 3.11.2, running on AWS Fargate behind ALB. Client init: `Client(api_key=..., timeout=10)` (they didn't set idempotency key).
sofia_platform: Noted: there was an internal change in 1.38 default retry behaviour (PR #4287) — the default retry policy switched to "retry-on-all-errors" instead of "idempotent-only" for lower latency in noisy networks. That can retry non-idempotent POSTs when network jitter causes ambiguous responses. That explains duplicate charges.
raj_engineer: Oof. We should confirm whether idempotency header generation was also changed (we recently refactored the request-layer in the SDK). If SDK no longer auto-injects an Idempotency-Key for generate POSTs when users don't supply one, and simultaneously retries more aggressively, that could produce duplicates.
emma_support: Customer log shows header `X-Redwood-Idempotency: <missing>` on the first request. That matches your suspicion.
raj_engineer: Repro attempt from support env (quick):
```bash
python -c "from redwood import Client; c=Client(api_key='x');print(c._transport._retry_policy)"
# output shows policy.name=retry-on-all-errors
```
raj_engineer: Hypothesis: two-fold change in 1.38 — default retry policy and idempotency auto-key generation refactor.
sofia_platform: Confirmed on my side: code comment in 1.38 changed the idempotency injection into the transport; bug introduced where the header is only injected when `idempotency` kwarg is present. Previously we always injected a UUID for POSTs. That explains missing header + aggressive retries.
ops_oncall: Escalating to eng-runtime for hotfix. Tagging @raj_engineer to take lead. Also advise customer to roll back to a safe SDK release until we patch.
raj_engineer: Immediate mitigations for customer: 1) revert to 1.37.x where behaviour is stable, 2) or set explicit idempotency header when calling, 3) set environment flag to restore legacy retry behaviour. Provide commands below.
emma_support: Workarounds I gave the customer: 
- pip install 'redwood-sdk==1.37.6'
- Or set explicit header in their calls: `headers={'X-Redwood-Idempotency': uuid4().hex}`
- Or set env: `export RW_SDK_RETRY_BEHAVIOR=legacy` (server reads this and uses legacy retry policy in 1.38 until patch)
customer-ops: Tried `1.37.6` and spike drops to near-zero immediately. Thanks. They can patch to explicit header for now too.
raj_engineer: Adding repro steps for eng-runtime: 1) run minimal client without idempotency header against a stub that randomly drops connection to trigger retry, 2) confirm two POSTs are delivered, 3) run same test on 1.37.6 and confirm single POST with auto-key.
raj_engineer: Stack snippet for debug: 
```
File "/opt/app/.venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/redwood/transport.py", line 212, in request
  resp = self.http.post(url, headers=headers, data=body, timeout=timeout)
File "/opt/app/.venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/redwood/retries.py", line 87, in _retry_request
  if self.policy.should_retry(resp, err):
```
sofia_platform: I've opened internal ticket RWD-ENG-6321 and flagged for hotfix branch. We'll aim for a patch release (1.38.1) that: re-enables auto-idempotency-injection for non-streaming POSTs and restores previous default retry policy while we evaluate performance tradeoffs.
ci-bot: Linked ticket: https://redwood-inc.atlassian.net/browse/RWD-ENG-6321 :circleci: 
ops_oncall: Thanks — please post ETA for the patch and we'll keep customer updated. Also note: billing team flagged a ~$1.2k spike; accounting wants attribution.
emma_support: I'll keep the customer updated and confirm when they can upgrade. For now they've locked to 1.37.6. :thumbsup:
